cards.title: IUPAC Compendium of Chemical Terminology (Gold Book)
supports: Allenes contain a central carbon bonded to two adjacent carbons by contiguous double bonds; the two pi bonds are orthogonal, constraining terminal groups to perpendicular planes.
Delocalization describes electrons distributed over more than two atomic centres.
Resonance contributors are individual valence-bond formulas; the real entity is a static superposition/hybrid, not a dynamic equilibrium.
Conjugation requires continuous alternating single and multiple bonds with uninterrupted parallel p-orbital overlap.

cards.title: Atkins' Physical Chemistry (11th ed., Oxford University Press)
locators: ISBN 978-0198769866, Chapter 10: Molecular Structure and Valence Bond Theory
ISBN 978-0198769866, Chapter 11: Molecular Symmetry and Rotational Barriers
supports: Hybridisation (sp, sp2, sp3) is a mathematical valence-bond construct mixing atomic orbitals to reflect geometry, not a physical force.
Sigma bonds have cylindrical symmetry about the internuclear axis, preserving orbital overlap upon rotation.
Pi bonds arise from lateral p-orbital overlap with nodal planes containing the bond axis; rotation twists p-orbitals out of coplanarity, destroying pi overlap.
Internal rotation in ethane preserves axial sigma overlap (barrier ~12 kJ/mol is steric/torsional), while twisting ethene breaks the pi bond (barrier ~260 kJ/mol).

cards.title: Organic Chemistry (Clayden, Greeves, Warren, 2nd ed., Oxford University Press)
locators: ISBN 978-0199270293, Chapter 31: Stereochemistry of Allenes and Cumulated Dienes
supports: Allene central carbon is sp hybridised with two unhybridised p-orbitals perpendicular to each other; maximum pi overlap requires terminal p-orbitals to align with central p-orbitals, forcing terminal CH2 groups into perpendicular planes.
Planar ethene cannot be directly transferred to allene because a single carbon cannot provide two coplanar p-orbitals for two perpendicular pi bonds.
Buta-1,3-diene possesses a continuous 4-centre conjugated pi system spanning C1-C2-C3-C4.
Penta-1,4-diene has an intervening sp3-hybridised methylene (-CH2-) carbon lacking unhybridised p-orbitals, which completely insulates the two isolated pi bonds.

cards.title: Inorganic Chemistry (Housecroft & Sharpe, 5th ed., Pearson)
locators: ISBN 978-1292134147, Chapter 5: Bonding in Polyatomic Covalent Molecules
supports: Nitrate (NO3-) and carbonate (CO3(2-)) have strict D3h symmetry with three identical planar sigma bonds from sp2 central atoms (N, C).
The unhybridised 2pz orbital on the central atom overlaps laterally with 2pz orbitals on all three oxygen atoms, forming a delocalised 4-centre pi system.
Observed bond lengths are identical and intermediate between single and double bonds, disproving localized oscillating single/double bonds.
Bond equivalence is a symmetry property of the molecule; it does not imply sp2 hybridisation without evaluating total electron domains (counterexamples: linear sp CO2, pyramidal sp3 NH3).

advanced_extension_source_requirement: FULFILLED: Official IUPAC standards and standard university textbooks (Atkins, Clayden, Housecroft) provide primary/authoritative verification for allene orthogonal stereochemistry, nitrate/carbonate delocalisation, rotational barriers, and conjugation pathways.
